scientific.integrity: The alternating-gradient first moment is solved exactly, the source momentum-squared second moment is reduced to an exponentially weighted average with an exact damping floor, and the limiting normalized update and raw-gradient ablation are compared algebraically.
limitations: Input-response theorem rather than fixed-objective global convergence.
Raw-gradient comparison holds the source damping placement fixed as an ablation.
No claim about stochastic generalization or whether high-frequency restoration is beneficial.

title: AdaMomentum cancels momentum attenuation at the alternating-gradient frequency
